verdict.rationale: Publishing delegated-access rules (authorization forms, representative roles, acts reserved to the applicant) is a fair question for an immigration agency, so the axis applies. The pack's only item is a failed TLS probe of robots.txt: nothing on the host was fetched, so there is no evidence either way.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
